outcome: Abundances of specific bacteria (Enterobacter, Klebsiella, Sphingomonas, Acidovorax, Azospirillum, Caulobacter, Flavobacterium, Magnetospirillum, Rubrivivax)
cohort: A cohort of 67 pregnant women (36 with HDP and 31 healthy controls) and their offspring were recruited.
finding: This study demonstrates significant alterations and intergenerational concordance in the microbial communities of both maternal fecal and neonatal meconium samples in the context of HDP.
cross-section timing: Maternal samples collected during the third trimester; neonatal samples collected at birth.
